sponsored.t: Prohibits certain election officials from overseeing an election if they are a part of a political action committee or independent expenditure committee for a candidate
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain election officials from overseeing an election if they are a part of a political action committee or independent expenditure committee for a candidate; defines "political action committee" and "independent expenditure committee".

sponsored.t: Relates to recognizing postpartum psychosis as a condition distinct from postpartum depression and directing the department of health to create screening guidelines for the condition
sponsored.sum: Relates to recognizing postpartum psychosis as a condition distinct from postpartum depression and directing the department of health to create screening guidelines for the condition and provide information to maternal health care providers.

sponsored.t: Regulates certain bounty websites
sponsored.sum: Regulates certain bounty websites which offer meme currency in exchange for completing tasks are consistent with New York state law; defines "meme currency"; authorizes the attorney general to ensure bounty websites are compliant with the law.

sponsored.t: Exempts the city of New York from the regulation of frozen desserts
sponsored.sum: Exempts the city of New York from the regulation of frozen desserts.

sponsored.t: Prohibits elected officials from collecting retirement while still in office when the retirement is earned from an elective public office
sponsored.sum: Prohibits elected officials from collecting retirement while still in office when the retirement is earned from an elective public office.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain employees with the state from using nonpublic information to gain advantage on prediction markets
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain employees with the state from using nonpublic information to gain advantage on prediction markets; establishes penalties for using nonpublic information on prediction markets.

sponsored.t: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school
sponsored.sum: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to the repair of damaged pesticide containers
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to the repair of damaged pesticide containers.

sponsored.t: Relates to certificate of residence policies for community colleges
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state university trustees to promulgate rules or regulations relating to late fees and exceptions for students submitting certificate of residence forms, and a reconciliation process for such forms received after the list of non-resident students was sent to a county.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring gas and electric corporations to disclose certain information with an application for a major rate change
sponsored.sum: Requires a gas and electric corporation to disclose certain information with an application for a major rate change; requires information relating to dividends paid to shareholders, capital investments, and policy expenditures; requires each application to include a dividend forecast covering the requested rate period.

sponsored.t: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance
sponsored.sum: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance including both scripted and unscripted.

sponsored.t: Relates to consumer warnings regarding rifles, shotguns, and firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to consumer warnings regarding rifles, shotguns, and firearms; provides that a graphic warning that depicts the nature of the health and safety risks of firearms be provided when any license or permit is issued or amended.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation regarding the management of fluke-summer flounder
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation regarding the management of fluke-summer flounder to December 31, 2029.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a statewide multi-agency integrated data system for certain violations relating to motor vehicle registration and use
sponsored.sum: Establishes a statewide multi-agency integrated data system for certain violations relating to motor vehicle registration and use which may be accessed by local law enforcement agencies for the issuance of fines, tickets, or notices of liability related to traffic offenses.

sponsored.t: Expedites MTA capital project construction by establishing a process for utility relocation necessary for such construction
sponsored.sum: Expedites MTA capital project improvement, construction, reconstruction, or rehabilitation by establishing a process for utility relocation necessary for such project.

sponsored.t: Enacts online revenues and expenditures transparency act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the online revenues and expenditures transparency act to provide for the development of a single, searchable budget database website accessible to the public, at no cost.

sponsored.t: Requires certain retailers stock nicotine replacement therapy products
sponsored.sum: Requires certain retailers stock nicotine replacement therapy products; establishes procedures in how nicotine replacement therapy products may be sold.

sponsored.t: Creates shared housing rooming units in new class A multiple dwellings or buildings converted to class A multiple dwellings
sponsored.sum: Creates shared housing rooming units in new class A multiple dwellings or buildings converted to class A multiple dwellings; creates new regulations in the New York city building codes.

sponsored.t: Requires at least one director on a board of directors be a primary resident of the residential cooperative housing corporation and prohibits certain charges by such corporations without 30 days notice
sponsored.sum: Requires at least one director on a board of directors of a residential cooperative housing corporation be a primary resident of such residential cooperative housing corporation; prohibits the charging of payments, fees or charges by cooperative housing corporations without thirty days written notice to such cooperative housing corporation's shareholders.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city office of technology and innovation provide NYC 311 outgoing call data from incarcerated individuals to the board of corrections
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city office of technology and innovation provide NYC 311 outgoing call data from incarcerated individuals to the board of corrections in monthly increments.

sponsored.t: Reduces the amount of signatures needed for a person to be nominated for the office of member of the city council
sponsored.sum: Reduces the amount of signatures needed for a person to be nominated for the office of member of the city council to four hundred fifty signatures to be aligned with city law.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain pet food from sales taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain pet food from sales taxes to include specialty pet food.

sponsored.t: Relates to clarifying state committee powers
sponsored.sum: Relates to clarifying state committee powers where it concerns old and new officers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of ATVs and off-highway motorcycles in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of ATVs and off-highway motorcycles in the city of New York; provides enforcement mechanisms and penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to artist preferences in housing
sponsored.sum: Relates to artist preferences in housing; provides that giving occupancy preference to individuals who are involved in artistic activities is not an unlawful discriminatory practice provided that such preference is implemented or authorized by an agency or the state of New York.
